title: PixlAudio shared library render manifest (pixl.library.render v1)
description: lib/v<libV>/<videoId>/sp-<profile>.json in the R2 bucket (docs/handoff/2026-11-10-plans/cloud-audio-spec.md, section 3.1). The worker writes it LAST, after the audio it describes, so its presence means the render is complete; nothing in the library is ever updated in place. A phone accepts a manifest only when schema, v, libV, videoId, kind and profile are what it asked for and, after the download, the file's bytes and sha256 match. Unknown fields must be ignored.

libV.description: The library version the render was made for (1 today); the same number as in the key.

kind.description: Always spatial; the field stays so that other kinds can be added later without a new schema.

source.description: The song the render was made from.

itag.description: YouTube's itag of the stream the phone played, as the job said (library.source); null when it did not say.

codec.description: That stream's codec, as the job said; null when it did not say. Not the codec of the upload, which the phone may have decoded to FLAC.

decodedSamples.description: Frames per channel of the decoded upload.

stems.description: Whatever produced the stems: the model_id of the worker's six-stem separator (open-cascade-6). The separator is a replaceable part; a new one comes with a new libV.

stemMode.description: What the renderer made of the stems. stems6: six stems. stems4: four. mix: no usable stems, the stem-free render.

samples.description: Frames per channel; equals source.decodedSamples: the file keeps the source's timeline, with no added delay.

integratedLufs.description: ITU-R BS.1770 integrated loudness of the file.

sourceLufs.description: The same for the song it was made from.

headroomDb.description: How far under the source the render was levelled on purpose: 4.0 (integratedLufs = sourceLufs - headroomDb, within 0.3). The app gives it back whenever its own playback gain has the room.

limiterMaxDb.description: The deepest gain reduction the true-peak limiter applied; 0 when it stayed idle.
